summary.intent: Resolve all open PR review comments from CodeRabbit on the cipher-box-docs-phase-19.1 branch by triaging, fixing valid issues, and replying/resolving each thread.
summary.outcome: Fixed one valid comment (fetch vs axios inconsistency in the customInstance mutator in 19.1-02-PLAN.md and a reference in 19.1-03-PLAN.md), marked two comments as not applicable with reasoning, committed and pushed the changes, and replied to/resolved all three threads.

repo: The project is in phase 19.1 (extract-core-crypto-sdk-as-shared-package) under .planning/phases/19.1-extract-core-crypto-sdk-as-shared-package/
rootIpnsName, rootFolderKey, and teeKeys are internal SDK state discovered dynamically — they are NOT consumer config fields (per CONTEXT.md line 49)
packages/crypto is already at v0.24.2 (coupled to root monorepo versioning); only NEW packages in this phase start at 0.1.0
The orval-generated client is configured with client: 'axios', so the customInstance mutator must use axios (AxiosRequestConfig/AxiosError), not the native fetch API

code.finding: customInstance mutator was incorrectly using fetch instead of axios despite client: 'axios' orval config. Fixed to use AxiosInstance, AxiosRequestConfig, and AxiosError. Also updated barrel export to include ErrorType and BodyType.
Contained a stale reference to 'fetch-based mutator' that was updated to reflect the axios-based approach after the 19.1-02 fix.

workflow: Edit tool requires exact whitespace matching — needed to shell out (cat -A) to inspect tab vs space characters before edits would apply
CodeRabbit comments on planning/documentation files (not source code) can be valid — treat .md plan files as first-class review targets
When a reviewer suggests resetting a package version, verify whether it is a pre-existing package (keep version) vs a net-new package (start at 0.1.0) before acting

friction: Edit tool failed silently on whitespace mismatch — required a Bash cat -A inspection step to identify tab vs space difference on line 253 before the edit could succeed
Multiple re-reads of the same files (19.1-02-PLAN.md read 5+ times) due to needing to confirm exact content before each edit attempt
open_items: Thread 2 (rootIpnsName/rootFolderKey/teeKeys as consumer config fields) was marked not applicable — if the SDK contract evolves to expose these as optional config, this decision should be revisited
Thread 3 (packages/crypto version reset to 0.1.0) was deferred — worth confirming with team that the versioning strategy (coupled vs independent) is intentional and documented
